objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed paperless artifact in DHC VISION, including policies, guidelines, procedural instructions, work instructions, and other documents.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: The selected type of the document.

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: The level used to differentiate and structure documents.

attributes.name: reference
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to master data or other documents.

attributes.name: it_application
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to IT applications.

attributes.name: relevant_company
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties for relevant companies.

attributes.name: area_of_validity
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties for areas of validity.

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Document type abbreviation included in the document name by default.

attributes.name: number_per_type
attributes.description: Cross-client consecutive 4-digit number assigned for each document type by default.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Title component of the document name.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Default composed name of the document.

attributes.name: metadata
attributes.description: Standardized and customer-specific metadata maintained automatically or by the user.

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: Grouping of attributes and metadata according to purpose.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version information for the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status of the document in its status network or workflow.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document using TAG technology.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign reader authorizations via user group assignment.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign the author of the document.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign additional personal change rights.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign reviewers for the document.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign releasers for the document.

attributes.name: releaser_including_translation
attributes.description: Attribute used for releaser assignment including translation.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the document validity count starts.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period for which an extended validity check is necessary.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date calculated from valid from date and period of extended validity.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration for which an invalidated document is archived.

attributes.name: distribution_by_info
attributes.description: Attribute whose changes affect e-mail notification on next released version.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: Attribute whose changes affect workflow task distribution on next released version.

attributes.name: original_language_version
attributes.description: Language version used as the original for translation.

attributes.name: login_language
attributes.description: Language in which authorized readers can see a released language version.

attributes.name: client_visibility
attributes.description: Specifies in which clients the document is visible in a multi-client system.

objs.name: policy
objs.description: Document type containing company-wide regulations and processes at a strategic level.

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: Document type for locally defined regulations or regulations relating to a business process.

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: Document type describing specific procedures, process sequence, details, and responsible persons.

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: Document type documenting detailed work steps relevant for few departments.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template defined for a document type and selected when creating new objects.

objs.name: information_object
objs.description: Object attached in the system when creating new documents or adding objects to a document.

objs.name: external_file
objs.description: File uploaded to a pure object cover.

objs.name: ms_office_format
objs.description: Standard office format used to generate new documents, such as Excel, Word, or PowerPoint.

objs.name: pdf
objs.description: Converted format displayed on the web after a document is saved.

objs.name: authorization
objs.description: Read and change rights assigned to users, persons, or groups for documents.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group of users used for authorizations, reader assignment, distribution, roles, and archive access.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: System or license role associated with a user group.

objs.name: person
objs.description: Individual assigned authorizations, workflow roles, or distribution.

objs.name: user
objs.description: System user participating in document management, workflows, roles, and distribution.

attributes.name: system_role
attributes.description: Role implemented in DHC VISION to provide appropriate functions.

attributes.name: license_role
attributes.description: License role shown in brackets for system roles.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Document attachment not subject to the main document release cycle and without its own release cycle.

attributes.name: criticality
attributes.description: Lack of criticality permits direct deletion.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document added to a main document and automatically released with it.

attributes.name: content
attributes.description: Attachment content affects the associated version of the main document.

attributes.name: versioning
attributes.description: Attachments are subject to their own versioning.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Attachments pass through all statuses of the main document release process.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal for a document change managed without affecting document content or version history until scheduled.

attributes.name: note
attributes.description: Note about an existing change proposal that can be printed in a new document version.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Completed change proposals are no longer displayed in the document.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task assigned to workflow participants in release, acknowledgement, validity, override, or reactivation workflows.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status and existence of workflow tasks communicated by e-mail notifications.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature used by workflow participants and documented for each released version.

objs.name: signature
objs.description: Individual participant signature documented in the system and printable as document content.

objs.name: released_version
objs.description: Released version of a document for which signatures are documented.

objs.name: version
objs.description: Document version created through revision, reactivation, or changes.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Number of the version.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status of the version.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: Request created by the system before validity expires and linked to the document to be checked.

objs.name: request_for_aks
objs.description: Request used to invalidate released documents that have no additional validity.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created to re-validate invalidated documents.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List maintained per document assigning user groups or persons for release information or acknowledgement.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Type of distribution maintained in the system.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation by recipients that they have taken note of a document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Acknowledgement status used in reports and overview.

objs.name: e_mail_notification
objs.description: Notification sent to users about workflow tasks, releases, change proposals, distribution, or validity processes.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: User and role-specific display filled based on distribution groups and role information.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Evaluation report available for documents in the system.

attributes.name: selection_parameter
attributes.description: Parameter used to influence evaluation results.

attributes.name: selection_criteria
attributes.description: Criteria used to filter result lists.

attributes.name: evaluation_result
attributes.description: Results influenced by parameters and criteria.

attributes.name: traffic_light_system
attributes.description: Status display using green, yellow, and red thresholds.

objs.name: document_list
objs.description: Reader dashboard listing documents relevant to the user.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: Translated or original language-specific version of a released document.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Language of the version.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Release state of the language version.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system in which document visibility can be specified.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Process to which documents can be linked by database integration.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Organizational unit to which documents can be linked by database integration.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Risk to which documents can be linked by database integration.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Master data to which documents can be linked by database integration.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: Example of master data to which documents can be linked.

objs.name: company
objs.description: Relevant company maintained via document properties.

objs.name: area_of_validity
objs.description: Area of validity maintained via document properties.

objs.name: department
objs.description: Organizational area for which detailed work steps are usually relevant.

objs.name: archive_group
objs.description: Specific user group retaining read access to archived documents.

objs.name: business_admin_group
objs.description: Group permitted to create requests for reactivation.
